facts.variant: TL431 standard accuracy, C temperature grade; not TL432, A/B or I/Q
facts.conditions: Sections 8.3 and 9.2.2.2.3 describe compensation without an output capacitor; added cathode-to-anode capacitance must be considered against the applicable stability curves. Section 9.4 requires supply current limiting to respect cathode current and limiting REF current. Section 9.5 advises nearby bypass placement and appropriate current-carrying trace widths. Figure 9-16 is explicitly TL432 DBZ, not a TL431 pin-routing template. No universal capacitor/ESR recommendation, startup guarantee or board thermal approval follows.

source_issues.description: Figure 7-2 shows a positive Iref*R1 term and inward reference current, but section 9.2.2.2.1 prints a negative term. No manufacturer correction or reconciled source formula is asserted. Preserve both locators; a retrieved divider expression does not settle the discrepancy.

Supply range, load range, R1/R2/RSUP values and tolerances, actual bias and temperature, board thermal conditions and allowable dissipation are unspecified. Low-input/high-load regulation and high-input/light-load stress are unknown. A maximum required minimum is not a maximum allowed current; a typical minimum does not establish worst-case bias.

Actual load capacitance, ESR, parasitics, cathode voltage/current, temperature and any external loop are unknown. Figure 6-18 is typical at 25 C and no curve coordinates were digitized. It cannot establish arbitrary capacitor suitability, a universal ESR bound, phase margin, or complete optocoupler/SMPS loop stability.

Figure 9-16 is labeled TL432 DBZ, not TL431. Generic bypass/current-limiting prose is retained, but its pin-number drawing is not transferred to TL431CDBZR; use existing exact TL431 pin records. No circuit startup or thermal sign-off is provided.
